entries.body:
HISTORY [S1.1] Format was CSV via csv.writer default dialect, lineterminator \n; header id,title,owner,amount; one row per exported record ascending id; no records -> header only.
CURRENT [S1.2] Scope: role admin exports any project; other roles only records whose project in user['projects'], others silently omitted.
CURRENT [S1.3] Status: only 'active' exported unless params.get('include_archived') is True, then 'archived' too.
HISTORY [S1.4] Date filter originally on created.
CURRENT [S1.4, S3.2] params 'since' YYYY-MM-DD -> only records whose date >= since; date = 'updated' if record has one, else 'created'.
CURRENT [S1.5] Titles stripped of leading/trailing whitespace.
HISTORY [S1.6] Decision record: date filter introduced for monthly reconciliation runs.
CURRENT [S1.0] API export_records(records,user,params)->str; stdlib only; don't modify input; ignore unknown params; amount kept exactly as given; base: all records ascending id, values as given.
CURRENT [S2.1] role 'viewer' -> raise PermissionError, nothing exported.
CURRENT [S2.2] confidential True never exported, except when role admin and params.get('purpose')=='audit'; all other rules still apply to it.
CURRENT [S2.3] params 'max_records' int>=1: export only first N (ascending id) remaining after all other rules.
CURRENT [S2.4, S3.1] Obligation now active (format is JSON): top-level exported_by=user['name'] in every export. Orig: if format changes from CSV, every export in new format must include top-level "exported_by"=user['name'] (until withdrawn/changed).
CURRENT [S2.5] Obligation: if confidential records ever exported for purpose other than 'audit', export must include top-level "confidential_count" = number of confidential records in it.
CURRENT [S2.6] Residency: region 'eu' exported only if 'eu' in user['regions']; applies to admins too.
CURRENT [S1.1, S3.1] Format: json.dumps object with key "records": list of {id(int),title,owner,amount(str exactly as given)} ascending id; no records -> empty list. Plus exported_by.
HISTORY [S3.3] Note: web UI shows owner display name; exports keep stored owner.
